Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a head-on collision in Conroe, Texas. Driver 1 and Driver 2 were both still at the
scene when officers arrived, and Driver 1 stated that the vehicle had been struck at low speed. Driver 1 reoprted neck
and back starin and was evaluated by responding medical personnel. Passenger was also present in Driver 1's
vehicle, and both officers and a bystander confirmed that Passenger had been seated inside at the time of the
incident.
Officers observed only minor contact between the two vehicles. Damage to Dirver 1's vehicle appears on a different
side and at a different height than the front-end contact described by the parties. No independent witnesses to the
collision were identified, and no photographs or other reports of the event were located. Driver 1 has no known prior
damage to the vehicle on record. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy.
Officers documented the scene and released both drivers after statements were taken.
